question: Add a new method SyncWithCallback(ctx context.Context, cb func(meta *metadata.Meta)) error to the BucketStore. BucketStore is the primary object-storage-backed store used by Mimir and Loki for reading historical time-series blocks. Any wrapper or mock must implement this method.

files_to_modify.why: This is where the BucketStore struct is defined (line 396) and where SyncBlocks (line 736) already exists. The new SyncWithCallback method must be added here as a receiver method on *BucketStore. The method should follow the same pattern as SyncBlocks but invoke the callback cb(meta) for each block metadata encountered during the sync loop. The metadata import is already present (line 50: github.com/thanos-io/thanos/pkg/block/metadata).
files_to_modify.changes: Add a new method after SyncBlocks (after line 807): func (s *BucketStore) SyncWithCallback(ctx context.Context, cb func(meta *metadata.Meta)) error. The implementation should: (1) call s.fetcher.Fetch(ctx) to get metas, (2) iterate through metas sending each to concurrent workers via a channel, (3) for each meta, call cb(meta) before processing (i.e., before PreAdd and addBlock), (4) perform the same block removal and label sync as SyncBlocks. The callback gives callers (like Mimir/Loki wrappers) a hook to observe each block's metadata during sync.

key_details.struct_definition: pkg/store/bucket.go:396-461 — BucketStore struct with fields like logger, bkt, fetcher, blocks map, blockLifecycleCallback, etc.
key_details.existing_sync_method: pkg/store/bucket.go:736-807 — SyncBlocks(ctx context.Context) error fetches metadata via s.fetcher.Fetch(ctx), processes blocks concurrently with blockSyncConcurrency goroutines, calls PreAdd and addBlock for new blocks, removes stale blocks, and syncs advertise labels.
key_details.metadata_type: pkg/block/metadata/meta.go:66 — type Meta struct { tsdb.BlockMeta; Thanos Thanos } wraps TSDB BlockMeta with Thanos-specific fields.
key_details.block_lifecycle_callback: pkg/store/bucket.go:628-637 — BlockLifecycleCallback interface with PreAdd(meta metadata.Meta) error, and noopBlockLifecycleCallback implementation. This interface is NOT directly related to SyncWithCallback but shows the pattern for extensibility hooks in BucketStore.
key_details.initial_sync: pkg/store/bucket.go:809-830 — InitialSync calls SyncBlocks and then cleans up local blocks no longer in the bucket. A corresponding InitialSyncWithCallback could also be considered.

answer.implementation_notes: BucketStore is a concrete struct, not an interface, in the thanos repo. The statement 'any wrapper or mock must implement this method' refers to downstream consumers like Mimir (pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores.go, pkg/storegateway/bucket.go) and Loki that embed or wrap BucketStore — they would need to expose or delegate to this new method. Within thanos itself, only pkg/store/bucket.go needs modification.
